comparison.objective: Tip a push mower filter-side-up to access its blade without sending crankcase oil into the intake; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled reorientation of a large machine differs from precision fastener engagement, counterholding, collar adjustment, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Mower must rest on the correct side with blade accessible and no oil migration; the record omits final-pose, support, spill, and damage thresholds. Candidate uses quantified impact tests.
comparison.reason: Safe equipment tipping tests a different manipulation capability.
